theme: Kids back, and the Orlando week begins.
greeting: The girls are with you and Mike as of this afternoon, Dan, and today's calendar stayed clear. The pressure is on a couple of bookings and this weekend's Disney plan, not on today.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: Sat-Sun Sept 26-27 for all six of you; lodging and the car are set, tickets are not. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations and whether Magic Kingdom has a Halloween-party night that weekend before you buy.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. Book it refundable now and adjust the dates later; waiting genuinely costs money here.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the four-kid passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: The passport appointment needs rebooking now that you are back from Sept 20; it was due yesterday. Have the packet and the old expired books ready before the new date.

needsAttention.title: Claire's appointment in St Pete
needsAttention.detail: On your calendar tomorrow at 10:20 AM in St Petersburg, right after the kids arrived - worth building the morning around it.

schedule.title: Kids pickup
schedule.detail: Girls join you and Mike, then on toward the Orlando villa

flagged.title: Venmo request for mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver is requesting $50 for mowing on 9/17 - still unpaid.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn messages waiting
